p0.title: OFF SHFT Logo Crewneck
p0.descriptionHtml:
The O in OFF is a clock. The hands say 5:00.

Quitting time. The shift is done and the rest of the day is yours.

For the back deck, the boards and the drive up to the cottage.

Made to order and shipped to you.

Details

  • Left chest: the OFF SHFT logo, embroidered, 62.6 mm (2.5 in) wide
  • Fabric: lightweight garment-dyed fleece, 100% ring-spun cotton, 6.4 oz/yd² (217 g/m²)
  • Fit: relaxed

Which size? See Size & fit.

p2.title: Punched Out. Crewneck
p2.descriptionHtml:
Punched out.

Two words and a full stop, big on the front. Nothing else to say.

The shift is done, and this crewneck says so from across the parking lot.

For the back deck, the boards and the drive up to the cottage.

Made to order and shipped to you.

Details

  • Front: PUNCHED OUT., embroidered big on the centre front
  • Fabric: lightweight garment-dyed fleece, 100% ring-spun cotton, 6.4 oz/yd² (217 g/m²)
  • Fit: relaxed

Which size? See Size & fit.

p3.title: OFF SHFT Logo Sweatpants
p3.descriptionHtml:

Made to order and shipped to you.
